scientific_question: After a stateless current-Muon-matched hidden-side stage-64 chart removes topology staleness, which structured tangent best captures the remaining task-effective dense c_proj Muon motion: additional hidden-side rotations, output-side rotations selected on the stage-64 residual, or two-sided diagonal channel/singular scaling?

existing_evidence_not_to_repeat.finding: A stale-periodic hidden32-plus-output32 chart was only 1.0303x/1.0016x the equal-coordinate hidden40 control on current/future Frobenius recovery.
existing_evidence_not_to_repeat.finding_2: Extra hidden-side stage64 directions were task-effective under post-GELU output, train-gradient, validation-gradient, and finite-CE metrics; their weak end-to-end gain was not explained by Frobenius-only inactive directions.
existing_evidence_not_to_repeat.novelty_of_this_plan: Fit the production-qualified stateless-fresh hidden64 tangent first, form its exact current-direction residual, and select additive output/diagonal coordinates only on that residual. Compare each addition against an equal-or-larger-coordinate fresh hidden-only control.

inputs.fixed_validation_windows: Reuse the disjoint fit and holdout windows pinned by fixed_eval_indices_sha256 5ca31b59768e43de808ad5e206ed152a4a0a3515ad68d29a0b2338c4db140747.

causal_protocol.dense_target: Use the exact coherent pre-step Muon polar direction at each base update, including the registered learning-rate schedule and decoupled-weight-decay convention.
causal_protocol.fresh_hidden64: Select and natively validate 64 edge-disjoint hidden-channel perfect matchings from the exact current dense target, then fit the closed-form diagonal-metric angles.
causal_protocol.residual: Materialize the actual hidden64 tangent/applied direction in c_proj weight space and define residual R = D_muon - D_hidden64 without using future state.
causal_protocol.output_addition: Select output-row Givens connectivity and angles from R only, then compose it additively with the already fitted hidden64 direction.
causal_protocol.diagonal_addition: Fit left/output and right/hidden diagonal scaling tangents to R only, both separately and jointly, then compose them additively with hidden64.

metrics.aggregation: Report every layer/update/window cell, energy-weighted aggregate, minimum cell, and coordinate-normalized gain. No aggregate may hide a nonfinite or negative-task-effect cell.

output_branch_pass: At either 32 or 64 output stages, the conditional-output candidate must beat its exact equal-coordinate hidden-only control by at least 1.05x on current post-GELU positive-line recovery.
It must beat the equal-coordinate hidden-only control by at least 1.05x on both fit and holdout validation-gradient predicted CE decrease.
It must win at least 7 of 8 fit/holdout finite-step CE comparisons and have no negative current-task-effect cell.
Its 15-update future residual recovery must be at least 1.10x the equal-coordinate hidden-only control.
diagonal_branch_pass: The joint two-sided diagonal candidate must beat fresh_hidden72, despite using fewer coordinates, by at least 1.05x on current post-GELU positive-line recovery and both validation-gradient predicted CE metrics.
It must win at least 7 of 8 fit/holdout finite-step CE comparisons and have no negative current-task-effect cell.
registered_decision_rule.hidden_capacity_signal: Fresh hidden80 is a control, not an automatic promotion. Call hidden capacity material only if it improves over fresh hidden64 by at least 1.15x on current post-GELU positive-line recovery and both validation-gradient predicted CE metrics, with at least 7/8 finite-step wins.
registered_decision_rule.selection: If multiple branches pass, select only the lowest-coordinate branch with the largest conservative minimum of holdout predicted-CE ratio, finite-step win rate, and future residual-recovery ratio.
registered_decision_rule.failure: If no branch passes, reject sparse orthogonal-plus-diagonal c_proj expansion as the next repair and return to a qualitatively different moving task-aligned chart; do not authorize another 124M training run.
